sections.body: Pass protection against LAC's base rush is the first decider. LAC sends five or more rushers on 23.9% of dropbacks [mc1] over 305 plays [mc2], and NYJ has allowed an 18.2% pressure proxy [mc5], so keep help in for the tackles. Second, the run game: O.Hampton takes 54.4% of LAC's carries [mc7], and 40.7% of designed runs go left [mc9], so NYJ must set the edge and win first down. Third, the money downs: LAC converts 32.3% of third downs [mc12], ranking 32nd [mc13] in the league, but its defense holds opponents to a 35.8% conversion rate [mc14], ranking 9th [mc15]. Fourth, the red zone: LAC's defense allows touchdowns on 54.3% of red-zone drives [mc16] over 35 drives [mc17], so getting into the red zone is the prize.
